name: Rene Fortuna
source: A shrine maiden who is a descendant of the Ale tribe. Despite her parents still being alive, Rene decided she loved [url=/c44894]Aria[/url] and became her adoptive daughter. Although her magic powers are inferior to Aria's, they are still quite strong, but Rene refrains from using them because she has yet to learn how to control them properly.
